questions.stem: At what Leatherworking skill can you place the Tanning Rack?
questions.explanation: The Camp Tent comes at skill 20, the Tanning Rack at 140 and the Sewing Machine at 300.

questions.stem: Blizzard says the more advanced Leatherworking recipes need which camp object?
questions.explanation: Blizzard names the Tanning Rack. The Camp Tent (skill 20) and Sewing Machine (skill 300) are the other Leatherworking camp objects.

questions.stem: What does Journeyman Leatherworking training need?
questions.explanation: Journeyman needs skill 50 and level 10, Expert skill 125 and level 20, and Artisan skill 200 and level 35.

questions.stem: Up to what skill does Apprentice Leatherworking go?
questions.explanation: Apprentice goes up to 75, Journeyman up to 150, Expert up to 225 and Artisan up to 300.

questions.stem: Which item does the Forever guide name as a craft that is Bind on Pickup for the leatherworker?
questions.explanation: The guide's example is Wisdom's Leather Boots. The Core Armor Kit is the tank kit that now gives +4 defense.

questions.stem: How much defense does the Core Armor Kit give in Forever?
questions.explanation: It now gives +4 defense instead of the +3 it gave before.

questions.stem: Which new armor kit adds spell power?
questions.explanation: Mystic Medium adds spell power, Forceful Medium adds attack power and Light adds Stamina.

questions.stem: A melee buyer wants an armor kit with attack power. Which new kit do you list for them?
questions.explanation: Forceful Medium adds attack power. Mystic Medium adds spell power and Light adds Stamina.
